title: Membership under index-language composition
statement: Let $f$ map binary strings to binary strings, let $p$ be a predicate on a binary string and a natural number, and let $w$ be a binary string. Then $w$ is an encoding of a pair $(x,\operatorname{bits}(i))$ with $p(f(x),i)$ true if and only if applying the following transformation to $w$ produces a string that is an encoding of some pair $(y,\operatorname{bits}(j))$ with $p(y,j)$ true: parse $w$ as a pair $(x,b)$; if parsing succeeds and $b$ is the canonical bit expansion of the natural number represented by $b$, output the encoding of $(f(x),b)$, and otherwise output the empty string.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from binary strings to binary strings
$p$ is a predicate on binary strings and natural numbers
